task: Fix parent workflow abort to also abort in-progress sub-workflow child executions, covering the store method, two UI call sites, and the WorkflowExecutionState type extension.

key_reasoning.reason: Three named production components touched: workflowExecutions.ts (store method), WorkflowExecutionHeader.tsx, and WorkflowExecutionStateControls.tsx, plus WorkflowExecutionState type in workflow.ts — 2 layers (Store/API + UI) with a soft external backend pre-condition.

The three frontend touch points are explicitly named, but the key pre-condition — whether the backend will expose sub_execution_id on execution state records — is unconfirmed, creating a gap that must be resolved before implementation can be finalized.

The abort pattern is well-established in the codebase, but abortWorkflowExecution has no existing unit tests and the backend coordination dependency introduces uncertainty about final scope; untested extension of a core store method elevates risk marginally above S.
